2607.16851.title: AgentBrew: Lifelong Knowledge Brewing from Strong Teachers to Weak LLM Agents
2607.16851.paper_summary: Deploying LLM agents typically requires a compact test-time student, even if a stronger teacher is available during training. We study knowledge brewing: distilling a teacher's interactive experience into a persistent external memory for the student. Crucially, this requires no weight updates, expert demonstrations, ground-truth labels, or test-time teacher access. This setting poses two challenges: environments provide only sparse, binary feedback, and teacher-authored notes must be inherently tailored to be concretely executable by a substantially weaker student. To address these hurdles, we propose AgentBrew, comprising two coupled components. First, a failure-triggered teacher--Ralph Loop mitigates sparse feedback by transforming student failures into environment-validated notes. Second, student-aware synthesis calibrates teacher knowledge to the weak executor's operational granularity, yielding model-specific, actionable guidance. Extensive evaluations and comprehensive ablations across coding, math, and tool-use tasks demonstrate that this asymmetric, training-free brewing paradigm produces highly capable yet deployable LLM agents.
2607.16851.paper_summary_zh: 部署 LLM 代理通常需要一個緊湊的測試時學生，即使在訓練期間有更強的教師可用。我們研究知識釀造：將教師的互動經驗提煉成持久的外部記憶供學生使用。關鍵是，這不需要權重更新、專家演示、真實標籤或測試時教師訪問。這種設置提出了兩個挑戰：環境僅提供稀疏的二元反饋，而教師撰寫的筆記必須本質上針對一個實質上較弱的學生進行具體可執行的定制。為了解決這些障礙，我們提出了 AgentBrew，由兩個耦合組件組成。首先，一個失敗觸發的教師——Ralph Loop 通過將學生的失敗轉化為環境驗證的筆記來減輕稀疏反饋。其次，學生感知合成將教師知識調整到弱執行者的操作粒度，產生特定於模型的可行指導。廣泛的評估和全面的消融實驗涵蓋了編碼、數學和工具使用任務，證明這種不對稱的、無需訓練的釀造範式能夠產生高度能力但可部署的 LLM 代理。
2607.16851.author: Yangqin Jiang et.al.
